changes: ~2026-10-08/09: At least 50 full-time staff (~8% of an insider-estimated ~650) were terminated across engineering, product, and cybersecurity in the US and India. The company says 'less than 5% of the company left', and it is profitable and still hiring. CEO Foody on X: 'It wasn't a layoff... We're profitable, have $1B+ in cash' (https://sf.gazetteer.co/mercor-cuts-at-least-50-employees-across-multiple-teams)
2026-10-08: Launched Mercor Research (evals through post-training), with hires including LoRA first author Edward J. Hu (https://www.mercor.com/blog/why-mercor-is-building-a-research-team/)

2026-10-13: Mercor and 1Password announced an SRE incident-investigation agent built on Codex (Forbes: https://www.forbes.com/sites/timkeary/2026/10/13/mercor-built-an-ai-agent-to-automate-sre-heres-what-happened/)
~$20B round: still not announced as closed as of 2026-10-21 (no new reporting found since The Information on 2026-08-19); $10B (Oct 2025) remains the last confirmed valuation

Context not in the Oct 9 file: after a 2026-03-31 data breach, Meta paused its work with Mercor indefinitely, and secondary reports cite at least seven class actions (https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/mercor-valuation-doubles-to-20b-on-revenue-growth--bloomberg-93CH-4727819; https://theinference.org/article/mercor-cut-at-least-50-staff-by-two-sentence-email-and-its-ceo-says-that-was-not-a-layoff)
notes: The brief mentions a ~$20B round 'reported in talks on Oct 9'. I found no new Oct 9 report: the $20B talks trace to Bloomberg/Forbes (Jul 9) and The Information (Aug 19). The '$1B+ in cash' figure comes from the CEO only (single source). The ~650 headcount is insider-reported and unconfirmed by Mercor, so the headcount field is not updated. The ID of Foody's reply on X could not be found, so it is not cited.

scoreAdjustmentReason: Nick Cammarata's 2026-10-15 post reached ~4.4M views and ~19.7k likes (verified via fxtwitter).
